headline: Rowan allows six goals across the entire season
dek: Sixteen wins, one draw, and one loss defined a season in which Rowan scored 59 goals across all matches while keeping opponents quiet. An unbeaten conference slate carried the program into mid-November before Dickinson handed it its only defeat.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring in the NJAC splits into clear tiers, with Rowan's 59 goals exceeding the combined total of New Paltz, William Paterson, and Ramapo.

wire.line: TCNJ posted fifteen wins, three draws, and two losses while conceding eleven goals, yet still trailed Rowan.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches past their scheduled date carry no published result, and both belong to New Paltz, away to Dominican of New York and Vassar.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Rowan midfielder Sara Wiedeman recorded fourteen goals and sixteen assists on 71 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: New Paltz goalkeeper Jess Centeri made 80 saves while allowing seventeen goals for a 0.825 save percentage.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: TCNJ spread its 56 goals across at least seventeen different players.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: William Paterson conceded 39 goals, more than Rowan, TCNJ, and Montclair State allowed combined.

last_match.line: Rutgers-Camden closed its season with consecutive shutout victories at home.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
